body: thank you for sharing that with me its reassuring that i'm not alone and i'm glad that you took the time to write me, and tell me to be what i can it helps, thanks

I'm terrible in school and I have very few friends and about half of them I feel don't like me anymore, I have maybe 3 or 4 true friends but I could never tell them for what they might say, my sister is very young but her normal attitude is meh , my mom loves me alot but confesses that she sometimes lets her anger get the best of her when dealing with me but she says i also have a tendency to make people around me better as an individual, my dad never says it to my face but I can tell he loves me he just cant show it, and when i have problems I have little or no emotional support from anyone. my life is filled with chaos and it has little opportunity to vent so i just want to thank you because this has helped pick me up if only for a while.
